messages:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — we need to finalize the marketplace onboarding checklist for AWS / GCP / Azure. Main blockers: account mapping, SKU consolidation (SaaS vs AMI), legal asset ownership, and who owns the pricing matrix. Can we assign owners?
Maya Patel: I can own SKU mapping for AWS + GCP. Will pull current SKU list and highlight duplicates. ETA EOD Mon. :thumbsup:
Devin Ortiz: Legal heads-up: we need a confirmed EULA + data processing addendum before we publish. Who's owning the legal copy? @Priya?
Priya Nair: I will coordinate with legal. Also handling logos, marketing assets, and vendor contact info. Putting a doc link here: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketplace/onboarding (draft)
Samir Rao: For Azure, we have to choose between Marketplace SaaS offer vs VM image. Recommend SaaS offer for hosted customers, AMI/VM only for Dedicated. I'll draft a short pros/cons and propose default SKU mappings.
Maya Patel: Found 3 duplicate SKUs across regions — one is legacy. I'll create a consolidated mapping. Small sample JSON I'll drop into the doc: ```json
{"sku_consolidation": [{"old_sku":"rwd-std-v1","new_sku":"rwd-core-1"},{"old_sku":"rwd-legacy","new_sku":"rwd-core-1"}]}```
Devin Ortiz: Legal needs a clear statement of asset ownership for images and logos. If we publish AMIs, we must declare who maintains them and who signs off on security scans. Add a field in the checklist: `maintainer_contact` and `scans_attested`
marketplace-bot: Automated reminder — onboarding ticket #PL-8842 created and assigned to partnerships. Due date 2026-03-30.
Alex Chen: Action items so far: 1) Maya — consolidated SKU map (EOD Mon). 2) Priya — legal contact + assets (start today). 3) Samir — Azure offer recommendation + pricing delta. 4) Devin — draft required legal clauses (EULA + DPA). Please add the Jira IDs to the doc.
Priya Nair: Noted. Also need confirmation on billing model: per-token vs seats vs instance-hour for Dedicated. Can product weigh in? @Samir you mentioned pricing delta — does that cover billing models?
Samir Rao: Yes — I'll sketch a pricing matrix with columns: offer_type (SaaS/AMI), billing_unit (per_token/seats/hr), baseline_price, marketplace_fee. Sample row I will add to the doc.
Maya Patel: Quick question on entitlements: do we gate feature flags by SKU in the marketplace licensing, or handle entitlement via our own license server? Need to decide before we publish.
Devin Ortiz: Legal prefers server-side entitlements (we control revocation). But partners sometimes require marketplace entitlement for automated provisioning. Let's document both and choose per-offer.
Alex Chen: Good point. Let's do a table in the doc with recommended default per offer. Priya, can you confirm which marketing assets (sizes/filetypes) the marketplaces require? I can upload once you confirm.
Priya Nair: AWS wants 1024x1024 PNG, GCP prefers SVG + PNG, Azure needs both. I'll upload originals and exported versions to the shared bucket.
Maya Patel: I'll add AMI manifest notes and the list of required AMI metadata (owner id, region list, tests passed).
Samir Rao: For SI/partner integrations, we should include a contact field and expected lead time for integration (e.g., 2 weeks for basic SSO + entitlements). I'll add that to the onboarding checklist.
Alex Chen: Timing — let's aim to finish the draft checklist by EOD Monday so we can run it in the Tuesday partnership sync. If anyone needs help, ping me.
Devin Ortiz: I'll post a short legal checklist snippet into the doc tonight.
Priya Nair: Uploading logos and marketing pack now. Will comment in the doc once done.
marketplace-bot: Reminder scheduled — partnership sync meeting on 2026-03-31 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent).
Samir Rao: Updated the doc with pricing matrix stub. Ping me for numbers.
Maya Patel: Consolidation draft uploaded. Left notes on two ambiguous SKUs.
Alex Chen: Excellent. Closing loop — everyone update the shared doc with Jira links and minutes. We'll review on Tuesday. Thanks! :raised_hands:
